meta.display_name: PLOS journals (PLOS ONE submission guidelines, representative)
meta.status_detail: Round 1 (workspace proposal 3674c0c1) migration. Verified 2026-09-11 against journals.plos.org/plosone/s/figures and journals.plos.org/plosone/s/submission-guidelines, treating PLOS ONE as representative of the PLOS family.

source.note: PLOS uses the ICMJE ('Vancouver') numbered-bracket citation convention.
Figures must be 300-600 dpi; 300 is the floor value used here, not broken out by art type in the general guidance.
